messages:
ryan.sales: Heads-up — new POC request from BetaFin. They are behind a corporate egress proxy and will only permit a small set of external IPv4s. They want: (1) static outbound IPs we can provide for a 2-week Dedicated POC, (2) a scoped time-limited API key, (3) a rough cost estimate.

Tess.runtime: We can support with Redwood-managed egress for Dedicated. We typically allocate 2 public IPv4s per POC and publish them for allowlisting. Alternative is Private/VPC or customer NAT -- but for speed, managed egress is best.

Omar.netops: Agree. I can reserve a 2-IP NAT pair in the region. Need to know: desired region, whether they need TLS passthrough vs proxy intercept, and any egress port restrictions (mostly 443). Also confirm they cannot allowlist hostnames-only.

ryan.sales: Region: us-west-2. They confirmed only IPv4 CIDRs. They do TLS inspection and will need to allow raw TCP 443 to our IPs (no interception of certs).

Nina.sec: Security items: send POC intake form and short DPA. Confirm retention window for logs (default is 7 days for POC) and whether they want request bodies stored. Also need SOC2 link and contact for security review.

Paul.billing: Ballpark: 1 GPU Dedicated for 14 days -> ~$1,600
$2,500 depending on model and token volume. Egress add-on pro-rated ~ $60
$150 for 2 weeks. We'll issue a short PO-friendly quote PDF.

ryan.sales: Can someone draft a short allowlist packet + curl I can PM the customer? Also I need the exact expiry format for the API key (ISO date ok?).

Tess.runtime: Draft below — placeholders in <>. Replace with Omar's IPs and PO number before sending. API key expiry: we use RFC3339 date-time (e.g., 2026-04-10T23:59:59Z).

```
Allowlist packet for BetaFin
- Service hostname: dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.ai (TLS)
- Outbound IPs to allowlist (example): 34.201.45.210, 34.201.45.211
- Ports: TCP 443 outbound
- Purpose: Allow outbound requests from BetaFin VMs to Redwood Dedicated POC for 14 days
- POC window: 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-15
- Contacts: ryan.sales@redwood.ai, omar.netops@redwood.ai, nina.sec@redwood.ai

Firewall rule example:
- permit tcp any host 34.201.45.210 eq 443

Sample curl (replace key):
curl -X POST https://dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer POC_KEY_RFC3339_EXPIRY_2026-04-15T23:59:59Z" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
```

Omar.netops: I'll create ENG-4210 and allocate the /32 addresses. Will post the canonical IPs in this thread and the ticket. Note: if their proxy rewrites SNI or TLS certs, we will need a short tech call.

nina.sec: Added POC intake link: https://redwood.sharepoint/poc-intake. Please have BetaFin complete before we hand out the key. Default log retention = 7 days; we can extend if they request.

provision-bot: Created ticket ENG-4210 for egress IP assignment and POC key provisioning: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4210

ryan.sales: Perfect, I'll send this immediately and loop in their infra lead. Please post the final IPs and quote PDF to the ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
